page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.24xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores with 96 vCPUs, utilizing a 1-to-1 thread-to-core ratio that eliminates hyperthreading overhead. The system is powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture.

The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 50 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between instances and external services.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and compute-heavy ratio make this instance suitable for workloads requiring consistent CPU execution without resource contention. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs reduces overhead for purely CPU-bound tasks. This hardware profile is designed for high-compute workloads such as batch processing, scientific modeling, video encoding, and large-scale web serving.
